newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Progressive allots workers 2.7 mln options.
newsitem.headline: Progressive allots workers 2.7 mln options.

text.p: Progressive Enterprises Ltd said on Friday it had allotted to a total of 675 eligible employees 2,750,100 options to purchase shares pursuant to the terms and conditions of the company's 1997 Employee Share Option Plan.
Last month Progressive said it had formed a share option plan for its senior and long-serving employees.
The scheme involves about 4.2 million options, exercisable at NZ$1.42 over periods starting October 1999 and expiring in December 2002.

Progressive also proposed to offer 750,000 options on identical terms to managing director Graeme Kelly, subject to shareholder approval. The board said aligning the interests of employees and shareholders would encourage long-term commitment to the group.
Shares in the supermarket operator last traded at NZ$1.70.
Progressive is majority owned by Australia's Foodland Associated Ltd.
